IDQ20850
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Final Flood Warning for the Lower Paroo River (QLD)

Issued at 9:42 am AEST on Wednesday 4 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 6


MINOR FLOODING HAS EASED AT HUNGERFORD

The main flood peak along the lower Paroo River is now downstream of Hungerford, where the
river level fell below the minor flood level overnight Tuesday into Wednesday.
Further downstream, a Minor Flood Warning remains current for the Paroo River (NSW).

Paroo River downstream of Eulo:
Minor flooding has eased at Hungerford.

The Paroo River at Hungerford is currently at 0.95 m and steady, below the minor flood
level. The Paroo River at Hungerford is expected to remain below the minor flood level
(1.00 m).

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.

Latest River Heights:
Location                                    River Height   Tendency Time of Observation
Paroo River at Caiwarro                       1.29 m       Steady   9:00 am Wed 04/11/26
Paroo River at Hungerford                     0.95 m       Steady   8:10 am Wed 04/11/26

This advice is also available by dialling 1300 659 219. Warning, rainfall and river
information are available at http://www.bom.gov.au/australia/flood.
